verdicts.note: Carrying the ball forward shows a clearly higher scoring chance and is football-plausible.
The pass to Noah Fairley increases scoring probability and is a reasonable alternative.
The pass to Sami Okoro also raises the chance to score and is a credible option.

claim: Taking the shot produced a 4.5% chance to score, but carrying the ball would have given a 12.1% chance (+7.5 points), a pass to Noah Fairley would have been 8.6% (+4.1 points), and a pass to Sami Okoro would have been 9.2% (+4.7 points).
